create_house_from_files: create a House object from OBJ and JSON files with an optional cached map and robot radius
get_rand_house_with_room_type: get a random house from the config prefix that contains a living room
create_render_api: create a RenderAPI instance with 250x250 resolution on GPU device 0
reset_environment_to_random_location: reset the environment to a random location within a specified room type
run_cubemap_rendering_loop: run an interactive cubemap rendering loop with keyboard controls for camera yaw and render mode switching
